answer: Agents deposit bonded stake, prove Semaphore membership, and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations support rate-limit proofs. Each message reveals a nullifier and a proof, not the identity. Two rate-limited messages in one epoch expose distinct polynomial shares; Shamir interpolation recovers the private identity key, producing evidence for immediate collateral slashing. This trellis of proofs gates the ocean of anonymous traffic at a wharf without publishing identities.
